summary: PrfEmailMessages is a UserControl component within the HSPnet system designed for staff profile email message management. It provides an editable interface for viewing, adding, updating, and deleting staff-related email messages. The component leverages ASP.NET controls, supports data-binding to staff messages, and enforces workflow and validation logic for message operations.
purpose: Enable authorized users to manage staff email messages (add, edit, delete) in a controlled, validated environment tied to staff profiles. Operations are subject to session and permission checks, and workflow steps are managed through a web-based grid and modal detail forms.

workflows.name: Add Staff Message
steps: User clicks add button in the grid or empty data panel.
System switches FormView to Add mode and displays modal details.
User completes required fields.
System validates input.
On insert, session and StaffID are passed to ObjectDataSource.
If valid, new message is persisted and session is cached.
Page reloads to show updated grid.

workflows.name: Edit Staff Message
steps: User clicks edit button in grid for a row.
System switches FormView to Edit mode and displays modal details.
User modifies fields.
System validates input.
On update, session and StaffID are passed to ObjectDataSource.
If valid, message is updated and session is cached.
Page reloads to show updated grid.

workflows.name: Delete Staff Message
steps: User clicks delete button in grid for a row.
System calls StaffMessagesDelete with session and message ID.
Session is cached.
Page reloads to show updated grid.

workflows.name: View Staff Message
steps: Grid displays existing messages.
Details shown in modal form when row is selected.
If no messages and editable, empty data panel with add button shown.

business_rules: A valid UserSession is required for all operations.
ScreenIsEditable determines field and button availability.
Delete operation invalidates only if session is missing.
validations: TypeCodeID must be selected from DropDown during add/edit.
Session and StaffID must be set for data-binding operations.
conditions: Show add button only if grid has no rows and screen is editable.
Show edit/delete buttons based on ScreenIsEditable.
system_behavior: Grid and FormView controls are used for displaying, editing, and adding.
ModalPopupExtender used for showing detail modals.
Redirect to current page after operations.
dependencies: System.Web.UI.WebControls (GridView, FormView, ObjectDataSource, Panel, Label, LinkButton, Button)
Grid utility methods (for setup, switching modes, showing details, disabling fields)
exceptions: If UserSession is null during data select or update, operation is cancelled.
If input is not valid, insert/update is cancelled.
